_hinweis: Bildprompts aus copy/bildbriefing.md. Drei Stilfamilien in stilblocks. "szene3d": weiche 3D-Szenen nach den Kundenreferenzen, Navy und Orange, gluehende Verbindungen, heller Grund. Das ist die Leitfamilie fuer Argumentationssektionen. "produkt": fotorealistische Produktaufnahmen fuer Hero, Designbeispiele und A+ Module. "objekt": die alte reduzierte Einzelgegenstand-Familie, abgeloest, nur noch Archiv. Jedes Bild waehlt seine Familie ueber "stil". "rahmen": false schaltet das Nachrahmen ab. Aufruf: node scripts/gen-bilder-openai.mjs --only <kennung>

stilblocks.objekt: Minimal 3D render, one single subject, nothing else in frame. Matte material, soft neutral studio light from one side, one soft shadow. Clean white background with a large amount of empty space around the object. Colour palette strictly limited to deep navy blue (#023047), amazon orange (#FF9900), white and light warm grey. No other colours, no gradients across the frame, no glow effects, no connecting lines, no floating icons, no collage of multiple symbols. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no interface labels. No people, no faces, no hands. No Amazon logo and no Amazon interface. Calm, restrained, editorial. High detail, quiet composition.
stilblocks.produkt: Photorealistic e-commerce product photography of a premium consumer brand. Clean even studio lighting, soft natural shadow under the product, no harsh reflections. Tack sharp focus, very high detail, shot straight on at product height with a normal lens, no wide-angle distortion. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no printed labels, no engraving and no branding of any kind, neither on the product nor anywhere in the scene. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts. Calm neutral colour world. Nothing else in the frame that competes with the product.
stilblocks.szene3d: Soft 3D render in a clean premium product-illustration style, the look of a high-end SaaS website illustration. Matte plastic surfaces with generously rounded corners and soft bevels. Colour palette: deep navy blue (#243B55) and a lighter slate blue for depth, amazon orange (#FF9900) as the single bright accent, white and very light cool grey. No other bright colours. Soft diffuse studio light from above, one gentle contact shadow directly beneath each object, no harsh highlights, no reflections. Thin glowing orange connector lines where elements relate to each other. THE SUBJECT IS COMPLETELY ISOLATED ON A FULLY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: no backdrop, no studio sweep, no ground plane, no floor, no horizon, no vignette, nothing behind or around the objects. Three-quarter isometric view. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels and no interface copy anywhere. No people, no faces, no hands. Crisp, calm, high detail.
